options.name: affinity
options.description:
Describes whether the HA resource are supposed to be kept on the same node V(positive),
or are supposed to be kept on separate nodes V(negative).
Required if O(type=resource-affinity).

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: comment
options.description: Description

options.name: disable
options.description: Whether the HA rule is disabled. If not specified, the Proxmox API default C(false) will be used.

options.name: force
options.description:
Existing rules with a specific O(type) can not be changed to the other type.
If V(force=true), the existing rule will be deleted and recreated with the new type.

options.name: name
options.description: HA rule identifier.

options.name: nodes
options.description:
List of cluster node members, where a priority can be given to each node. A resource bound to a group will run on the
available nodes with the highest priority. If there are more nodes in the highest priority class, the services will
get distributed to those nodes. The priorities have a
relative meaning only. The higher the number, the higher the priority.
It can either be a string C(node_name:priority,node_name:priority) or an actual list of strings.
Required if O(type=node-affinity).

options.name: resources
options.description: List of HA resource IDs. It can either be a string C(vm:100,ct:101) or an actual list of strings.

options.name: state
options.description: create or delete rule

options.name: strict
options.description:
If false, the HA resource can also be moved to other nodes if there is none of the specified nodes available.
If not specified, the Proxmox API default C(false) will be used.

options.name: type
options.description: HA rule type.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).
